load_lora_adapter: load a LoRA adapter from a safetensors file into the diffusion pipeline for later application
set_lora: set LoRA adapter(s) on transformer modules with configurable strength and target selection
merge_lora_weights: merge LoRA weights into the base model for specified transformer modules at a given strength
unmerge_lora_weights: unmerge LoRA weights from the base model and disable on-the-fly LoRA computation
get_lora_status: get a JSON-serializable dict of loaded adapters and their active application status per module
